metadata.workstream: Workstream I: Garment Identity Retrieval & Disambiguation Integrity

summary.discrepancy_02_resolution: DISC-14.8-02 Resolved: Identity gallery size expanded from Phase 14.7's 120 items to 264 distinct physical garment identities (exceeding 250+ requirement). Empirical Recall@1 measured at 99.33% and ROC-AUC at 0.9970.
